caption: The drawing is executed in black ink on a beige or lightly yellowed paper. It features several views and details of a round table. At the top left, there is a plan view (top-down) of the table, showing a circular tabletop with two parallel support beams running horizontally, a rectangular mounting plate, and a central support that ends in a claw-shaped foot. To the right of the plan view, there is a small section drawing that appears to depict the profile of the table’s edge. Below, the main portion of the drawing shows a side elevation (profile) of the table, illustrating the round tabletop supported by a central, turned pedestal that transitions into three curved legs, each ending in a claw-shaped foot. To the right of the table's side view, there is an enlarged detail of the foot, showing the claw grasping a small ball. All lines are in black and there is no additional color or shading except for some hatch marks for dimension, particularly on the claw detail. The background is plain, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner.
title: Tilt-top Table
